overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: individual, non-relayed calls from the moderator to committee members did not show a quorum deliberating, and the matter was closed as resolved.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the committee deliberated outside a noticed meeting when the moderator polled its members individually about nominees to the Advisory & Finance Committee.
allegations.key_passage: Having been provided with no evidence showing communication between a quorum of the Committee, we find that no such improper deliberation occurred, and we find that the Committee did not violate the Open Meeting Law.
